stories.title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released a new AI tool called Astra that can use computers and web browsers on your behalf, doing tasks for you automatically.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and software engineers right now — nothing you need to act on yet.

stories.title: OpenAI’s next big AI model has ‘entered the AGI era’
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released a new super-powerful AI model called GPT-6 Astra that can handle complex jobs like cybersecurity, coding, and science work.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly important for engineers and IT professionals — most ordinary people won't interact with it directly.

stories.title: AI suggests new physics experiments that could outperform human-designed setups
stories.simple_summary: Scientists used AI to suggest new ideas for physics experiments that could work better than experiments humans designed themselves.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to scientists and universities — nothing you need to worry about in daily life.

stories.title: Ollie is betting its focus on privacy can help it win the AI assistant race
stories.simple_summary: A company called Ollie is making a new AI assistant for families that learns about your life but promises not to sell your private information to other companies.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're worried about privacy with AI assistants, this is worth keeping an eye on, but it's still very new.

stories.title: Nvidia to spend $13 billion on Hugging Face, which will remain an open source platform - ABC News
stories.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, a big computer chip company, is buying Hugging Face, a popular online library of AI tools, for about $13 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — it won't directly change how you use AI.

stories.title: Nvidia to buy Hugging Face to buy $12.9bn AI software deal
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia is purchasing Hugging Face, a major website where programmers share and use AI models, for nearly $13 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to tech investors and engineers — it doesn't affect everyday users.

stories.title: Nvidia launches free tool that links idle computers into a personal AI data center
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia released free software that lets you connect your home computers together to run AI tools privately on your own devices, without sending information to the internet.
stories.why_it_matters: If you want to use AI privately at home without sharing data with companies, this could be useful, but it's mainly for people comfortable with computers.

stories.title: Google now lets you chat with Gmail, Docs, and Keep
stories.simple_summary: Google added voice assistant features to Gmail, Docs, and Keep so you can talk to these apps instead of typing — like having a helper listen to your requests.
stories.why_it_matters: This could make Google's office apps easier to use if you prefer speaking instead of typing, though it's still being rolled out gradually.

stories.title: ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude all went down at the same time
stories.simple_summary: Several popular AI chatbots (ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude) all stopped working at the same time.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI services can have outages like any website — good to know if you rely on them.

stories.title: Google’s latest AI weather model gives you no excuse to forget your umbrella
stories.simple_summary: Google created a new AI weather prediction tool that forecasts rain and snow, and will put it into Google Search, Maps, and Gemini.
stories.why_it_matters: You might get more accurate weather forecasts in Google products, which could help you plan your day better.

stories.title: Google says its AI weather model is getting better
stories.simple_summary: Google improved its AI weather forecasting model to be more accurate at predicting rain, snow, and giving detailed local weather pictures.
stories.why_it_matters: Over time, this could make weather apps more helpful, especially for predicting sudden storms in your area.

stories.title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia confirmed it is buying Hugging Face, a major website with millions of AI models that millions of programmers use.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a business deal between tech companies — it doesn't immediately affect what most people do with AI.
